newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens transport division may show loss.
newsitem.headline: Siemens transport division may show loss.

text.p: German electronics and engineering giant Siemens AG said its transportation division may show a loss in 1996/97.

After a loss-making year in 1994/95, the division showed a 19 million mark pretax profit in 1995/96, but is still in restructuring, chief executive Heinrich von Pierer told the company's annual news conference.
Von Pierer said he still sees the transportation equipment business as a field with a future.
The KWU power generation unit, which builds power plants, should show above-average results this year, he added.
